We are seeking a Payroll Representative to support payroll delivery for Germany within the EMEAI region. This role ensures employees are paid accurately and on time, in compliance with local legislation, company policies, and agreed labor conditions. You will work closely with internal and external stakeholders, resolving payroll issues and contributing to a best-in-class employee experience.

Do you live just across the border in Belgium (for example in Ghent, Zelzate, or Assenede) and would you also like to get to work? That is possible! As an EU citizen with a valid identity document, you can also work in the Netherlands.

What you'll be doing

As Payroll Specialist, you will be responsible for:

    - Delivering Payroll, Time & Absence, and Data Management efficiently and accurately
    
- Processing payroll information with confidentiality and attention to detail
    
- Ensuring timely and correct payments to employees and local authorities
    
- Performing activities according to internal control and compliance frameworks
    
- Addressing employee payroll queries in alignment with Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
    
- Supporting process improvements and collaborate across functions and cultures

What’s in it for you:

    - Market-competitive salary with 8.33% holiday allowance and 13th month salary
    
- Travel allowance of €0.21 per kilometer (up to 75 kilometers one way)
    
- 8.0% holiday allowance and 29 vacation days
    
- 8.33% year-end bonus and a 13th-month salary
    
- Pension accrual from day one via Manpower
    
- Group discount on supplementary health insurance
    
- Contract via Manpower
    
- Access to 200+ online training courses via Manpower Academy

    - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in HR, Finance, or a related field.
    
- Fluency in English and German (written and spoken) is mandatory.

Preferred Skills:

    - Experience with MS Excel, Workday, ServiceNow, ADP GlobalView Payroll, and SAP.
    
- Ability to navigate high-volume operational environments.

You know when adjustments are needed and take action when something is not running as it should. Your responsibilities include: Operating production lines in the slicing department Receiving and checking incoming raw materials Supplying and removing products during the production process Setting up, adjusting and starting production lines and machines

Accuracy and responsibility are important, but so is teamwork. You’ll work independently while staying in close contact with your colleagues and keeping an overview of the production process. Where will you work? You will work at DeliBarn in Wijchen, a modern and important production location within the organization. Every day, high-quality meat products are produced, sliced, and packaged for major retailers and foodservice customers throughout Europe. The production site in Wijchen is equipped with advanced slicing and packaging technology and modern machinery. These technologies allow DeliBarn to process products efficiently while meeting strict food safety and quality standards. Within DeliBarn, innovation, quality, teamwork, and personal development are highly valued. The company continues to invest in modern technology and efficient production processes, giving employees the opportunity to learn, develop their skills, and grow within the organization. Apply today and become part of the DeliBarn team in Wijchen. Your next career step could start here!
